newsHighlights.title: Insured robots becoming irreversible wave
newsHighlights.summary: Chinese insurers are launching dedicated policies for robots as automated machines spread across factories, hospitals and hotels, a trend analysts describe as irreversible.
newsHighlights.translation: 随着自动化机器进入工厂、医院和酒店，中国保险公司正在推出专门的机器人保险产品，分析人士称这一趋势不可逆转。

newsHighlights.title: Chinese AI models see intl adoption surge
newsHighlights.summary: International adoption of Chinese artificial intelligence models has surged over the past year, driven by competitive pricing, faster iteration and open-source releases.
newsHighlights.translation: 过去一年，中国人工智能模型的国际采用量激增，主要得益于有竞争力的定价、更快的迭代速度和开源发布。

newsHighlights.title: Immersive experiences reshape inbound travel over National Day holiday
newsHighlights.summary: Foreign visitors to China are seeking immersive cultural and tech experiences during the National Day holiday, reshaping the country's inbound tourism market.
newsHighlights.translation: 国庆假期期间，来华外国游客热衷沉浸式文化与科技体验，正在重塑中国的入境旅游市场。

newsHighlights.title: Holiday travel highlights China's transport strength
newsHighlights.summary: Record passenger flows during the National Day holiday have highlighted the capacity and efficiency of China's transport infrastructure.
newsHighlights.translation: 国庆假期创纪录的客流凸显了中国交通基础设施的运力与效率。

quote.quote: Price is what you pay; value is what you get.
quote.author: Warren Buffett
quote.translation: 价格是你付出的，价值是你得到的。
quote.explanation: 巴菲特提醒投资者关注资产的内在价值而非短期价格。正如中国 AI 模型凭借高性价比赢得国际市场，真正的竞争力来自持续创造的价值，而非一时的低价。

vocabulary.example: Companies are willing to pay a higher premium to protect expensive automated equipment.
vocabulary.translation: 企业愿意支付更高的保险费来保护昂贵的自动化设备。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自今日《Insured robots becoming irreversible wave》：企业为机器人投保需按风险水平缴纳保费。

vocabulary.example: The new policy offers coverage for mechanical failure and third-party damage.
vocabulary.translation: 新保单为机械故障和第三方损失提供承保。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自机器人保险报道：保险公司为不同应用场景设计差异化的承保范围。

vocabulary.example: When a robot causes an accident, questions of liability become complicated.
vocabulary.translation: 当机器人引发事故时，责任认定问题变得复杂。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自机器人保险报道：公共场景中的事故责任划分是该险种的核心。

vocabulary.example: The adoption of Chinese AI tools has accelerated in Southeast Asia and Europe.
vocabulary.translation: 中国 AI 工具在东南亚和欧洲的普及速度加快。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自标题《Chinese AI models see intl adoption surge》。

vocabulary.example: International demand for Chinese AI models surged during the past year.
vocabulary.translation: 过去一年，国际市场对中国 AI 模型的需求激增。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自标题《Chinese AI models see intl adoption surge》。

vocabulary.definition: 不可逆转的，无法挽回的
vocabulary.example: Analysts believe the shift toward robot insurance is irreversible.
vocabulary.translation: 分析人士认为，向机器人保险的转变不可逆转。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自标题《Insured robots becoming irreversible wave》。

vocabulary.example: Rapid robot deployment in service industries is creating new demand for insurance.
vocabulary.translation: 服务型行业快速部署机器人，催生了新的保险需求。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自机器人保险报道：各行业机器人的投入使用推动了配套金融服务。

vocabulary.example: Robot-related policies are becoming a fresh source of revenue for insurers.
vocabulary.translation: 机器人相关保单正成为保险公司新的收入来源。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自机器人保险与 AI 产业报道：新技术为保险和软件企业带来新增收入。

vocabulary.example: Immersive experiences are reshaping inbound travel during the National Day holiday.
vocabulary.translation: 沉浸式体验正在重塑国庆假期的入境旅游。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 CGTN《Immersive experiences reshape inbound travel over National Day holiday》。

vocabulary.example: Holiday travel has highlighted the strength of China's transport infrastructure.
vocabulary.translation: 假期出行凸显了中国交通基础设施的实力。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自《Holiday travel highlights China's transport strength》：高铁与航空网络承载创纪录客流。

pattern.pattern: 主语 + see + 名词（短语）+ surge / rise / grow（标题式表达：……见证……激增）
pattern.example: Chinese AI models see international adoption surge.
pattern.translation: 中国 AI 模型见证国际采用量激增。
pattern.usage: 新闻标题中常用动词 see / witness 表示“见证、经历”，后接名词化结构，省略冠词和助动词。正文中可写成：Chinese AI models have seen international adoption surge over the past year. 表达“某事物经历了某种变化”时，比 experience 更简洁、更具新闻感。

grammar.title: 现在进行时（be + doing）表示正在发生的趋势
grammar.explanation: 新闻英语常用现在进行时描述正在发展、尚未结束的社会或经济趋势，突出动态变化与即时性。常与 becoming、reshaping、growing、increasingly 等词搭配，语气上强调“正在形成、值得关注”。
examples: Insured robots are becoming an irreversible wave in China's insurance market.
Immersive experiences are reshaping inbound travel over the National Day holiday.

pronunciation.tips: 共 4 个音节，主重音在第三个音节 -ver- /ˈvɜː/。开头的 /ɪrɪ/ 两个元音都要弱读为短促的 /ɪ/，不要读成“艾”；/v/ 是上齿轻咬下唇的浊辅音；/ɜː/ 是长元音，舌尖不卷起（英音）；词尾 /əbl/ 轻而短。整词读作：ih-rih-VER-suh-bl。
examples: Analysts say the trend toward robot insurance is irreversible.
Some environmental damage may prove irreversible.

reading.title: Robots, Insurance and AI: How China's Tech Economy Is Converting Innovation into Value
reading.content: As robots move from factory floors into hospitals, hotels and households, a new trend is taking shape in China's insurance market: policies designed specifically for machines. Industry analysts say insuring robots is no longer a niche experiment but an irreversible wave, as companies seek protection against accidents, malfunctions and liability claims. Premiums vary by scenario, and coverage now extends to third-party damage. At the same time, Chinese artificial intelligence models are winning wider acceptance overseas. Reports show that international adoption of Chinese AI tools has surged over the past year, driven by competitive pricing and faster iteration. Together, these developments show how quickly China's technology sector is converting innovation into commercial value. Demand for insurance, cloud services and integration support is creating fresh revenue for both insurers and software firms. For investors and workers, the message is clear: understanding automation and AI is no longer optional, because the future of business will be written by those who adapt first.
reading.translation: 随着机器人从工厂车间走进医院、酒店和家庭，中国保险市场正出现一个新趋势：专为机器设计的保险产品。业内人士表示，为机器人投保已不再是小众尝试，而是一股不可逆转的浪潮——企业希望借此防范事故、故障与责任索赔。保费因场景而异，承保范围如今已延伸至第三方损失。与此同时，中国人工智能模型在海外获得越来越广泛的接受。报告显示，过去一年中国 AI 工具的国际采用量激增，动力来自有竞争力的定价与更快的迭代速度。这些进展共同表明，中国科技行业正迅速把创新转化为商业价值。保险、云服务与集成支持的需求，为保险公司和软件企业带来了新的收入。对投资者和从业者而言，信息很明确：理解自动化与人工智能不再是可选项，因为商业的未来将由率先适应的人书写。
reading.sourceNote: 基于 ChinaDaily《Insured robots becoming irreversible wave》《Chinese AI models see intl adoption surge》及 CGTN《Immersive experiences reshape inbound travel over National Day holiday》等 2026-10-08 真实新闻改写，语言难度按中级学习者调整。
